nodes.summary: Let $k \ge 2$ be a natural number and let $J_k$ be the Josephus function; call $m$ low extremal if $1 \le J_k(m) \le k - 1$, and high extremal if $m + 1$ is low extremal. If $J_k(2k - 2) \le k - 1$, then $2k - 3$ is high extremal and $2k - 2$ is low extremal. If $J_k(2k - 2) > k - 1$, then $2k - 2$ is high extremal and $2k - 1$ is low extremal. In particular, $2k - 2$ is always a low or a high extremal point.
nodes.title: Extremal points of the Josephus function near $2k - 2$

nodes.summary: For every natural number $k \ge 2$, the set of natural numbers $n$ with $J_k(n) = n$ is infinite, where $J_k$ is the Josephus function.
nodes.title: The Josephus function has infinitely many fixed points

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $k$ and $m$, the point $m$ is a high extremal point of the Josephus function $J_k$ if $m + 1$ is a low extremal point of $J_k$, that is, if $1 \le J_k(m + 1) \le k - 1$.

Then $J_k(n_e + 1 + m) = j + km$ for every natural number $m \le \lfloor (n_e - (j - 1)) / (k - 1) \rfloor$.

nodes.summary: Let $k \ge 2$ and $n$ be natural numbers, let $J_k$ be the Josephus function, write $j = J_k(n+1)$, and suppose $j \le k - 1$. Then for every natural number $m$, $j + km \le n + 1 + m$ holds if and only if $m \le \lfloor (n - (j - 1)) / (k - 1) \rfloor$. Moreover, if $k - 2 + j \le n$, then $\lfloor (n - (j - 1)) / (k - 1) \rfloor \ge 1$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
